items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember Sam. He used to do a lot of sessions.

ctx.x: No. Sam’s last name’s something else. I don’t know where they got that Brolsh from. He died, too. I remember Sam. He used to do a lot of sessions. But Sam had another last name, like Wagner or something.
What caught my eye was Sir Roland Hanna – whom I had the pleasure of playing with – harpsichord. I never heard him play harpsichord. That’s what got me on this one.
